description: Size-optimized xz package of the FXCM2 PAQ5/PPMD100M cmix21 candidate. It keeps the same cmix source patches, dictionary, forced text mode, mmap allocation, PPMD cap, PAQ memory policy, and FXCM cmC2 divisor, but rebuilds the executable with -Os -s before xz packaging.
hypothesis: A size-optimized executable should materially reduce counted program payload while preserving cmix21's compression behavior closely enough to improve the final ledger. Because compiler flags can alter exact floating-point or optimization behavior, this candidate requires a replay rather than inheriting parent measurements.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
POSIX mmap and temporary filesystem space

source.patch: CMIX_FXCM_CMC2_DIV and CMIX_FXCM_RCM_DIV added to src/models/fxcmv1.cpp; PAQ8 memory divisor hooks retained in src/models/paq8.cpp; packaged executable built with -Os -s

verdict: Awaiting driver replay. Size-optimized build plus xz assets lower binary plus dictionary payload from 558,987 bytes to 328,588 bytes, a 230,399-byte counted-program reduction before wrapper delta. Exact archive behavior must be measured because the executable was rebuilt with different optimization flags.
